version.description: Schema version of this file. Currently 1.

enabled.description: Review every PR of the repository automatically. When false, only a PR carrying one of `labels` or whose description contains `description_keyword` is reviewed.

drafts.description: Review draft PRs too (otherwise they wait until ready).

base_branches.description: Regular expressions (full match) for base branches besides the default branch whose PRs are reviewed; `.*` = every branch.

labels.description: `label` reviews only PRs carrying one of the listed labels; `!label` never reviews a PR carrying it.

ignore_title_keywords.description: A PR whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive) is not reviewed automatically.

ignore_usernames.description: PRs by these GitHub logins (exact, case-sensitive) are never reviewed automatically.

description_keyword.description: With `enabled: false`, a PR whose description contains this is reviewed. Empty or null clears it.

auto_review.description: Which PRs without a Lumo task are reviewed automatically. PRs linked to a Lumo task are always scanned.

path_filters.description: Globs for the files the AI review reads: `!glob` excludes; once any `glob` is listed, only matching files are reviewed.

description: Lumo repository configuration (.lumo.yaml). Read from the base branch of each pull request.
title: .lumo.yaml
